children: Curaleaf issued a fact sheet disputing Aurora's statements and defending its US$4.00 offer, which it says implies a 45% cash premium and up to a 110% premium excluding Aurora cash.
Curaleaf released a fact sheet rebutting Aurora's criticisms of Curaleaf's proposal to acquire Aurora.
States the offer represents a 45% premium and a 110% premium excluding Aurora's cash on hand.
Accuses Aurora of dilutive ATM issuances at prices below Curaleaf's bid, questioning Aurora management's actions.
Contrasts Curaleaf's positive operating cash flow since FY21 with Aurora's negative operating cash flow and large impairments.
Defends deal structure: ~19% cash in the US$4.00 offer and a US$5.00 cap said to be in the 92nd percentile of Canadian M&A premiums.
